zh.lead: 今天最大的产品消息：OpenAI 扩展科研人员项目，向全球最多 20 万科研人员免费开放前沿模型，申请于 11 月 23 日开启，并发布对 1800 余名科学家的使用研究报告。产品侧，Hermes Agent 推出稳定版 v0.23.2，OpenClaw 正式发布 v2026.11.4。

important.title: 重要消息
items: OpenAI 于北京时间昨晚至凌晨更新：11 月 23 日开放申请，下轮发放 5 万个名额，每份资助覆盖申请者及最多两名合作者的 ChatGPT Plus，默认不以项目数据训练模型。同期报告覆盖 1,819 名科学家，受访者估计若没有 AI、要达到同等质量，耗时约为现在的 1.9 倍。
Hermes Agent 于今天 04:59 发布稳定版 v0.23.2，把自 v0.23.1 以来约 1,989 个已合并 PR 纳入稳定通道；完整整理的说明将随 v0.24.0 发布。OpenClaw 稳定版 v2026.11.4 已于昨天下午挂上 GitHub Releases，修复重连丢消息、设置重载丢回复等问题；beta.4 的 Releases 页也已挂出。
OpenAI 还为医疗团队推出更强的计算机使用代理，并新增 20 余个医疗插件；同时与 Apollo Research、METR、Transluce、Goodfire 签署首批嵌入式评估协议，向外部专家开放内部模型与系统的深度访问。

sections.title: 研究报告与医疗代理
sections.body: 试点已有 2 万名科研人员、33 个国家加入；98% 受访者认为 AI 会加速其所在领域的发现，68% 曾用 ChatGPT 做研究构思。分类由自动分类器完成，研究团队不阅读原始消息。医疗侧以合成数据演示：代理可在病历系统中查阅记录并起草预授权材料，交由人工审阅。

sections.title: DeepMind：Antigravity 纳入 Carbon
sections.body: 官方账号称，面向 1 万名科学家的 Google Antigravity 项目现纳入 Gemini 4 Carbon 免费使用权。线程举例包括：在数周内证明 Signal 密码代码的安全性、从实验记录中发现湿实验误差，以及检索到 40 倍更多相关蛋白序列。所附链接指向 11 月 10 日 Carbon 上市博文，未见单独新项目页。

sections.title: 产品栏
sections.body: DeepSeek Harness 仍为 rc.3。codex 稳定版仍为 0.169.0，实验线已到 alpha.10，发布说明仅标版本号；@thsottiaux 称容量错误或已修复，以推文为准。Claude 与 Cursor changelog 无新条目。Grok Bot changelog 仍为 v1.0.1，cask 仍报 1.1.0。CursorBench 4.0 较昨日无更新。

sections.title: 缺口
sections.body: @karpathy、@AndrewYNg、@AnthropicAI、@claudeai、@AIatMeta 与 @Meta 近 48 小时无高信号原创；关注列表无 DeepSeek 一手 X。OpenAI 新闻页今日抓取 403，改以官方 RSS 与已核对文章为准。Grok 1.1.0 与 Codex 实验标签不编造未写明的功能。

en.lead: Biggest product news today: OpenAI is expanding its researcher program to give up to 200,000 scientists worldwide free access to its frontier models, with applications opening November 23, and it published a study of how more than 1,800 scientists used the program. On the product desk, Hermes Agent shipped stable v0.23.2, and OpenClaw formally released v2026.11.4.

important.title: Headlines
items: Overnight in Asia/Shanghai, OpenAI said applications open November 23, with 50,000 grants in the next round, each covering ChatGPT Plus for the recipient and up to two collaborators; program data is not used for training by default. The companion report covers 1,819 scientists; surveyed participants estimated that reaching the same quality without AI would have taken about 1.9 times as long.

Hermes Agent published stable v0.23.2 at 04:59 Asia/Shanghai, rolling about 1,989 merged PRs since v0.23.1 into the stable channel; full curated notes will ship with v0.24.0. OpenClaw’s stable v2026.11.4 landed on GitHub Releases yesterday afternoon, with fixes for dropped messages after reconnects and lost replies after settings reloads; the beta.4 Releases page is also up.

OpenAI also advanced computer-use agents for healthcare teams and added 20+ healthcare plugins, and signed first-phase embedded-assessment agreements with Apollo Research, METR, Transluce, and Goodfire, giving outside experts deep access to internal models and systems.

sections.title: The study and healthcare agents
sections.body: The pilot has enrolled 20,000 researchers in 33 countries; 98% of survey respondents expected AI to accelerate discovery in their field, and 68% had used ChatGPT to develop research ideas. Automated classifiers labeled activity types; the research team did not read the underlying messages. On the healthcare side, a synthetic-data demo shows an agent reviewing records and drafting prior-authorization materials for a human to review.

sections.title: DeepMind: Carbon in Antigravity
sections.body: The official account said the Google Antigravity program for 10,000 scientists now includes free access to Gemini 4 Carbon. The thread cites proving the security of Signal’s cryptographic code in weeks, spotting wet-lab errors from lab notebooks, and finding 40 times more related protein sequences. The attached link points to the November 10 Carbon availability post, not a separate new program page.

sections.title: Product desk
sections.body: DeepSeek Harness remains rc.3. Codex stable remains 0.169.0; the experimental line has reached alpha.10, with notes that name the version only. @thsottiaux said capacity errors may have been fixed; that is treated as a tweet. Claude and the Cursor changelog have no new entries. Grok Bot’s changelog is still v1.0.1, and the cask still reports 1.1.0. CursorBench 4.0 is unchanged versus yesterday.

sections.title: Gaps
sections.body: @karpathy, @AndrewYNg, @AnthropicAI, @claudeai, @AIatMeta, and @Meta had no high-signal originals in the past 48 hours, and there were no first-hand DeepSeek posts on X. OpenAI’s news page returned 403 today, so this follows the official RSS and checked articles. Features are not invented for Grok Bot 1.1.0 or Codex prerelease tags.

title.zh: 向科学家更广泛开放 AI
title.en: Broadening access to AI for scientists

summary.zh: OpenAI 于 11 月 16 日宣布扩展「ChatGPT for Academic Researchers」。项目 7 月试点，已有 2 万名科研人员、33 个国家加入；下一轮 11 月 23 日开放申请，将发放 5 万个名额，每份资助覆盖申请者及最多两名合作者的 ChatGPT Plus，并可获得前沿模型使用培训。默认不以项目数据训练模型。已在等待名单且符合条件者，会在开放申请前收到激活说明邮件。
summary.en: On November 16, OpenAI announced an expansion of ChatGPT for Academic Researchers. The July pilot has enrolled 20,000 researchers in 33 countries. Applications for the next round open November 23, with 50,000 grants, each covering ChatGPT Plus for the recipient and up to two collaborators, plus training on using frontier models in research. By default, program data is not used to train models. Eligible people already on the waitlist will be emailed instructions before applications open.

title.zh: 前沿的科学：科学家如何使用 ChatGPT
title.en: Science at the Frontier: How scientists use ChatGPT

summary.zh: OpenAI 经济研究团队研究了暑期试点中 1,819 名科学家的约 58 万条科研相关消息，并调查 251 人。受访者估计，若没有 AI、要达到同等质量，耗时约为现在的 1.9 倍；98% 认为 AI 会加速其所在领域的发现；68% 曾用 ChatGPT 做研究构思。为保护隐私，活动类型由自动分类器标注，研究团队不阅读原始消息或模型回复。默认不以该项目数据训练模型。
summary.en: OpenAI’s Economic Research team studied about 580,000 scientific messages from 1,819 scientists in the summer pilot and surveyed 251 participants. Surveyed scientists estimated that the same work at the same quality would have taken 1.9 times as long without AI; 98% expected AI to accelerate discovery in their field, and 68% had used ChatGPT to develop research ideas. To protect privacy, automated classifiers labeled activity types; the research team did not read the underlying messages or model replies. By default, program data is not used for training.

title.en: Our first phase of embedded assessments

summary.zh: OpenAI 宣布与 Apollo Research、METR、Transluce、Goodfire 签署首批嵌入式评估协议，让独立评估方在较长周期内深入访问其内部模型与系统，以评估对齐和防护措施，并为安全案例提供补充。按评估需要，评估方可获得与内部研究相近的资源，包括模型检查点、源代码、训练与评估数据、监控系统、技术文档，以及与相关研究者、工程师的讨论。官方称这也支撑其在白宫超级智能协议下接受独立评估的承诺。
summary.en: OpenAI has signed first-phase embedded-assessment agreements with Apollo Research, METR, Transluce, and Goodfire, giving independent assessors deep access to internal models and systems over an extended period to evaluate alignment and safeguards, complementing its safety cases. Depending on what an evaluation needs, assessors may receive resources similar to those internal researchers use, including model checkpoints, source code, training and evaluation data, monitoring systems, technical documentation, and discussions with the researchers and engineers involved. The company says this also supports its commitments under the White House Accord on Super Intelligence to independent assessments of its safety controls.

alphaxivTop3.title: Unbundling Multimodal Vision Encoding
alphaxivTop3.authors: Ellis Brown, Chris Hoang, Shengyi Qian, Shang-Wen Li, Mike Lewis, Marjan Ghazvininejad, Luke Zettlemoyer, Lucas Beyer, Mengye Ren, Jakob Verbeek, Saining Xie, Hu Xu et al.

summary.zh: （热榜第 1，较昨日仍居首位）把多模态模型里视觉编码器的三项设计拆开对照：上游预训练带来的视觉先验、专用视觉容量，以及融合前放置。在统一数据与算力下从头训练后发现：视觉先验并非必要，联合从头训练的编码器可与预训练编码器相当。
summary.en: (Still #1 versus yesterday.) The authors unbundle three design choices in vision encoders for multimodal models: a visual prior from upstream pretraining, dedicated vision capacity, and placing that capacity before fusion. In a controlled from-scratch comparison at matched data and compute, the visual prior is not necessary; a jointly trained-from-scratch encoder is on par with a pretrained one.

alphaxivTop3.title: Training Reasoning Models in Simulation to Natively Use Real Robots
alphaxivTop3.authors: Jiaming Tang, Zhuoyang Zhang, Junxian Guo, Fangzhou Zhao, Yilong Zhao, Zekai Li, Xingyang Li, Yuyang Zhao, Song Bian, Zhijian Liu, Song Han

summary.zh: （热榜第 2，新上榜）指出机器人使用代理（RUA）的强结果目前主要来自 GPT-6 Astra、Claude Fable 5.2 等专有前沿模型。作者展示：一个开源权重的 27B 推理模型可以完全在仿真中、不依赖演示，用强化学习学会原生操作真实机器人；它像计算机使用代理一样观察环境、做思维链，并直接输出下一末端位姿，无需额外 harness。训练框架称为 PEAR，方法称为 RURL。仿真中在 LIBERO 与 RoboDojo 训练后，技能可迁移到未见过的机器人、真实世界和新指令；在真实双臂机器人上成功率为 60%，基座模型一次都未成功。
summary.en: (New at #2.) The authors argue that strong robot-use agents (RUAs) have so far come mainly from frontier proprietary models such as GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.2. They show an open-weight 27B reasoning model can be trained with reinforcement learning, entirely in simulation and without demonstrations, to use real robots natively: like a computer-use agent, it observes the environment, reasons in a chain of thought, and outputs the next end-effector pose, without a harness. They introduce PEAR and robot-use RL (RURL). After training on LIBERO and RoboDojo in simulation, skills transfer to an unseen robot, the real world, and novel instructions; the model succeeds in 60% of trials on a real dual-arm robot, versus none for the base model.

summary.zh: （热榜第 3，新上榜；昨日第 3 的 SLAM Dunk 今日降至第 4，昨日第 2 的 Latent Feedback 降至第 8）询问语言模型能否在不运行网络的情况下，预测一次权重编辑会如何改变行为，并称之为 weight-space reading。在预注册的三轮测试中，sandbox 阅读代理检查 Qwen3.8-27B、Qwen3.5-9B 与 Muse-Glimmer-30B 的权重。仅给权重和 Python sandbox 时，27B 对其自身非破坏性细微编辑的行为效应预测平衡准确率为 0.730，高于只给文字描述时的 0.578；零样本、且不做一次前向计算，就能恢复约三分之二的真实行为变化（文字描述组约为四分之一）。作者称交叉对照并未给出确定的「自我阅读」优势。
summary.en: (New at #3; yesterday’s #3, SLAM Dunk, falls to #4, and yesterday’s #2, Latent Feedback, falls to #8.) The paper asks whether a language model can predict what a weight edit will do to a network’s behavior without running the network, and calls this weight-space reading. In three pre-registered rounds, sandboxed reader agents inspect the weights of Qwen3.8-27B, Qwen3.5-9B, and Muse-Glimmer-30B. Given only the weights and a Python sandbox, 27B predicts the behavioral effects of subtle, non-destructive edits to its own weights at 0.730 balanced accuracy, versus 0.578 when given a text description of the same edits, and recovers about two thirds of the real behavior changes versus about a quarter—zero-shot and without a forward pass. The author finds no conclusive self-reading advantage in a crossed contrast.

summary.zh: 稳定版更新为 v0.23.2（published_at 2026-11-16T20:59:18Z，约北京时间今日 04:59）。发行说明称这是补丁版，把自 v0.23.1 以来约 1,989 个已合并 PR、7,918 个非合并提交纳入 CLI、安装包、Microsoft Store、Docker 与 Hermes Cloud 的稳定通道；完整整理的发行说明将随 v0.24.0 发布。说明列出了该窗口内若干能力（如可在网关重启后继续的 durable subagents、按会话的 prompt-cache 时钟、Gemini 4 Carbon 的 Interactions API 等），但同时写明这些内容「故意不在此完整记载」，故今日不把该清单写成正式功能介绍。发布候选还修复了桌面端发送、流式回复与重连后重复显示等问题。
summary.en: Stable is now v0.23.2 (published_at 2026-11-16T20:59:18Z, about 04:59 Asia/Shanghai today). The notes call it a patch that rolls about 1,989 merged PRs and 7,918 non-merge commits since v0.23.1 into the stable channel for the CLI, installers, the Microsoft Store app, Docker, and Hermes Cloud. Full curated notes will ship with v0.24.0. The text lists several capabilities from this window (such as durable subagents that survive a gateway restart, a per-session prompt-cache clock, and the Gemini Interactions API for Gemini 4 Carbon), but also says they are “undocumented here on purpose,” so today’s brief does not treat that list as a formal feature write-up. The release candidate also fixes desktop sending, streamed replies, and duplicate display after reconnects.

summary.zh: 稳定版 v2026.11.4 已于 2026-11-16T04:17:42Z（约北京时间昨天下午 12:17）挂上 GitHub Releases，昨天早报采集时尚未见到此页。官方说明称这是补丁版：修复重连后漏掉缓冲的 Signal 消息、设置重载后丢失回复，以及记忆与配置恢复副本损坏；并新增委托变更审批，以及允许策略插件在图像进入模型前先检查。规模为 125 个源 PR、90 位贡献者。完整说明见 https://docs.openclaw.ai/releases/2026.11.4 。此前仅有标签的预发布 v2026.11.5-beta.4（Telegram 交互组件及多项可靠性修复），今日 Releases 页也已挂出。主线在 beta.4 之后仍有提交，尚无更新标签。
summary.en: Stable v2026.11.4 landed on the GitHub Releases page at 2026-11-16T04:17:42Z (about 12:17 Asia/Shanghai yesterday); it was not there during yesterday morning’s collection. The notes call it a patch: fixes for dropped buffered Signal messages after a reconnect, lost replies after a settings reload, and damaged memory and configuration recovery copies, plus a delegated change-approval setting and a way for policy plugins to inspect images before they reach a model. Scale: 125 source PRs and 90 contributors. Full notes: https://docs.openclaw.ai/releases/2026.11.4 . The earlier prerelease v2026.11.5-beta.4 (Telegram widgets and reliability fixes) now also has a Releases page. Main has more commits after beta.4, with no newer tag yet.

summary.en: The official changelog Latest is still v1.0.1 from November 11 (the entry also includes 1.0.0): on Team / Enterprise / Ultra plans, the Bot can join Google Meet, Zoom, or Microsoft Teams from a link, reply in meeting chat, send a recap afterward, and use shared-login connectors. Per the client-versus-changelog rule, this is not described as “no new version in recent days”; 1.1.0’s features have not been listed officially, so none are invented here.

text.zh: 今日重心（周二去敏）：工作日继续推进生产与架构事项，重点包括云端质量指标核算、新一版 harness 设计的理解与对照，以及下一阶段 AI 提效（含 RSI）的工作思考；同时整理现有产品安全基线，作为月底安全架构工作的输入。学习侧继续技术文章阅读，并安排安全架构课（信任边界）、harness 工程与 RSI/DDD，以及 pstack 方向的研究；实体硬件上的语音问答按计划推进。通识课仍在进行中。
text.en: Tuesday focus (sanitized): on the work side, continue production and architecture items, including a cloud quality-metric calculation, a close read of the next-generation harness design, and thinking about the next stage of AI productivity work (including RSI); also pull together the current product security baseline as input for security-architecture work at month-end. On the learning side, keep up with technical reading, and schedule the security-architecture lesson on trust boundaries, harness engineering and RSI/DDD, plus pstack study; hardware voice-QA work continues as planned. The general-education course is still in progress.
